read.en: Rockwell Automation rose 0.5% on Oct 23 to $426.11, trading between $415.71 and $429.46 on 1.4 times average volume. It is below the rising 5-day ($428.2), falling 10-day ($427.9), rising 30-day ($430.6) and falling 100-day ($446.9) averages, and just under the rising 200-day ($426.4). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 13 and below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($442.60), and RSI is 46.
read.zh: 罗克韦尔自动化 10月23日上涨 0.5%，收于 $426.11，盘中区间 $415.71–429.46，成交量为平均水平的 1.4 倍。股价位于上行的 5 日（$428.2）、下行的 10 日（$427.9）、上行的 30 日（$430.6）和下行的 100 日均线（$446.9）下方，略低于上行的 200 日均线（$426.4）。MACD 自 10月13日起位于信号线及零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$442.60），RSI 为 46。

read.en: The $415.7 low undercut the $417.6–418.8 support, but the close recovered to just under the average cluster. Resistance is $426.4–430.6 (5, 10, 30 and 200-day), then $436 (Sep 8 high) and $441.4 (Oct 21 high). Support is $415.7–418.8, then $412.7–413.9 (Oct 15 and 20 lows) and $406.9 (Sep 17 low). A close above $430.6 would target $436–441; a close below $412.7 would open $406.9.
